index.title: Assemble a Tax Return from Email
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Assemble Tax. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Assemble a Tax Return from Email. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user used a chatbot to assemble a tax return from a large number of emails. They connected their Gmail account to find the necessary documents and used a tax preparation website to fill out the return. The chatbot identified missing forms
index.bot_name: The tax return, assembled from 40,000 emails
